title: Retrospective brief, 2026-11-03: the lessons of 39 run-reports, rated, with one decision to take

sections.name: summary
sections.label: In short
sections.content: For the first retrospective session (handbook, Measurement and retrospective; never held). Twenty distinct lessons from section 7 of the 39 run-reports to 2026-11-03, each with its recurrence, its trace in the programme and a keep / change / drop / done disposition; the four indicators and nine measurement results with a suggested rating so the owner only agrees or overrules; one recommended decision with three alternatives. Ten minutes to read. Prepared by a read-only pass; the editor reports have no numbered sections, so their lessons come from the closing paragraphs. Only the 10-31, 11-01 and 11-03 editor reports have an explicit "What we learned".

sections.name: brief
sections.label: The brief
sections.content:
39 `run-report` records read (24 TPR, 14 editor, 1 real use). Key: keep / change / drop / done.

## 1. Lessons in section 7

| # | Lesson | First | Last | n | Trace | Disposition |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | group-state and I1 window roll over at the 11:30 close: a close-time read is always empty | 10-24 | 11-03 | 10 | none (tools.md: `cycleStart..now`) | **change**: measure and close read the cycle just closed |
| 2 | Budget reads 0/10 while the owner merges by hand; owner-merge is the bottleneck | 10-22 | 11-03 | 6 | clerk#164, #166 open; muDemocracy.org#373 | **change**: I2 counts quorum-carrying merges by gate; budget is a sub-line |
| 3 | Pause works but costs a cycle per silent day; reports read as a heartbeat | 10-19 | 11-02 | 5 | finding 77568b7f; clerk#167 closed, #65 open | **change**: one-line ack counts; an owner-away notice suspends the pause |
| 4 | Proposals left in `draft` are invisible to the session agenda (one hid 83h) | 10-20 | 10-25 | 3 | clerk#239 open | keep (ship #239) |
| 5 | Fed queue, not review, is the limit; analyst rate sets throughput | 10-18 | 10-31 | 3 | allocate 2026-10-27 "groups starve" | keep (filed) |
| 6 | Rejected PRs need a builder to move; red gates hold work for days | 10-25 | 11-02 | 3 | finding cb59a41b; clerk#235 open | keep (filed) |
| 7 | Reviewer rejections are specific enough to act on; Door 2/3 stops as designed | 10-28 | 11-03 | 3 | decision 199dd369 | keep |
| 8 | Schema-mirror drift reds every open PR after a spec merge; sync before review | 10-25 | 10-27 | 2 | clerk#235 open | keep (fold into #235) |
| 9 | Escalation drafts wait days; nothing surfaces them before the next report | 10-22 | 11-03 | 2 | none | **change**: steward comments on #31 the hour an escalation is filed |
| 10 | A ruling does not clear `needs-input` on the issue it answers | 10-27 | 10-31 | 2 | none | **change**: session record names issues to relabel; `clerk session` does it |
| 11 | Decision record on a separate programme PR stalls after the code merged | 10-18 | 10-18 | 1 | none | **change**: record rides the code PR, or upkeep carries both |
| 12 | An "other" ruling has no route to a task | 10-21 | 10-21 | 1 | clerk#132 closed | **change**: "other" writes a needs-input note on the source issue |
| 13 | Quorum comment names a decision with no record; nothing to ratify | 10-24 | 10-24 | 1 | none | **change**: reviewer names the record id; pr-check fails without it |
| 14 | Proposal path has no review step (8487fd7a merged without assent) | 10-30 | 10-30 | 1 | none | **change**: decision PRs carry a reviewer line like code PRs |
| 15 | Builder omits the PR classification line | 10-28 | 10-28 | 1 | srs#716 closed; clerk#224 open | keep (#224) |
| 16 | Two correct rulings can collide; an engine rule must hold them | 11-03 | 11-03 | 1 | 42fcc319 open | keep (filed) |
| 17 | Real use: no author recorded; argument package heavier than used | 10-21 | 10-21 | 1 | srs-web#618; remedy c21da256 | keep (filed) |
| 18 | Mandate chain works when affirmation comes first | 10-31 | 10-31 | 1 | editor report | keep |
| 19 | Resolved: builder clock trigger (5 reports, srs-programme#131); report PRs sitting open (2, merge-on-green); duplicate escalations folded; srs#236 audit scope (b80d2d1e); routine env value (finding 6dbfc61c) | 10-10 | 10-23 | 10 | as listed | done |
| 20 | Nine editor reports carry no section 7 | 10-20 | 10-30 | 9 | finding cccf2f6e | **change**: template requires section 7; pr-check fails without it |

## 2. Indicators and results (suggested rating)

Indicators:
- **I1 Is work grounded?** useful: the one computed measure; right question, real baseline (5%).
- **I2 Does work flow?** misleading as defined: 0/10 for 11 cycles while 5 to 15 PRs merged (lesson 2). Redefine before computing.
- **I3 Does governance keep up?** useful, uncomputed: lessons 4, 9, 10 are what it would show. Compute first.
- **I4 Does done mean done?** useful, uncomputed; no report touched it; lowest priority.

Results (all I1, evaluator pending):
- 5762dd13 (10-04..10-11, 15/297): useful; the only window large enough to mean anything.
- 74b7cd7d, f5b58565, 7cc47de3, 2a16eeb1 (0/0, 10-28 to 11-03): misleading; window opened at the close, measures nothing (lesson 1).
- abdd5bd3 (1/3), c027f838 (0/2), 8470c9f4 (0/1, editor), c19cc6d6 (0/1): noisy; n of 1 to 3, same wrong window.

## 3. Recommended retrospective decision

**Keep I1, I3, I4; change I2 and the measure window; drop the close-time per-cycle I1 result.** `measure` reads the cycle just closed; I2 counts quorum-carrying merges by gate; per-cycle I1 becomes a weekly I1 over all merged PRs. The ten "change" lessons (1, 2, 3, 9, 10, 11 to 14, 20) become one clerk issue each, filed by the steward with `Answers:` the measurement problem (decision 24d985d1).

Alternatives:
- **Keep as is**: eight more empty results a week to rate.
- **Drop measurement until I2 to I4 exist**: ends the noise, loses the baseline and the only proof the loop closes.
- **Change the window only**: empty results stop; the budget line still reads 0 while work lands (lesson 2 recurs).

sections.content: Derived from the review 7b2c742f and finding cccf2f6e (received reports leave no trace). The session acts it asks for: rate the nine results (the i key once clerk#264 lands, or in comments until then), and ratify or amend the retrospective decision, which the steward proposes in the decision log once clerk#268's check is in place.
